result.rationale: In parseRefreshTokenResponse, `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` injects a fake sentinel when the minimum schema path is taken. In office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts the result is spread over existing credentials (`o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...tokenResponse.data }`) and then persisted via `prisma.credential.update`, so the real refresh_token is irrecoverably overwritten with the literal string 'refresh_token' whenever credential sharing is enabled. Same mechanism plausibly applies to other callers persisting the parsed result.
